spans.s: Śoṇa, a river. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 373 (among the rivers in Varuṇa's palace).--§ 276 (Jarāsandhavadhap.): II, 20, 796 (crossed by Kṛshṇa, etc., on their way from Indraprastha to Rājagṛha).--§ 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 85, 8150 (ºsya Jyotirathyāyāś ca saṅgame), 8151 (ºsya Narmadāyāś ca prabhave (B. prabhede) …Vaṃśagulme).--§ 459 (Mārkaṇḍeyas.): III, 188, 12910 (seen by Mārkaṇḍeya in the stomach of Nārāyaṇa).--§ 494 (Āṅgirasa): III, 222, 14233 (among the rivers who are mothers of fires).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 337 (enumeration of the rivers of Bhāratavarsha; both C. and B. have Śoṇāṃ).
Śoṇitoda, a Yaksha. § 269 (Vaiśravaṇasabhāv.): II, 10, 399 (in the palace of Kubera).
